_comment: Round 36: separate adjudication of six set-S labels questioned in the error analysis after the first scoring (the labels were written from a keyword view that missed dates lower on the page). labels.json and the frozen S results are NOT changed; decisions.py --adjudicate applies these overrides in memory and reports them as a separate result.
